how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-un-goro-crater-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4284:obj:0: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to ⟦E1⟧ at Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4284:details:0: I'm sure you've noticed 'em, ⟦1⟧. They're everywhere!
rows.quest:4284:details:1: What am I talking about? Why, the crystals, of course!
rows.quest:4284:details:2: The crystals... They're all over the crater. Most people ignore them, but I have a strange feeling that they hold power within them. I've been doing experiments here with them for a while, but I can't seem to find anything. Well, I haven't yet, anyway.
rows.quest:4284:details:3: Say, I'm running a little low on the crystals I have here -- think you might be able to collect some more for me?
rows.quest:4284:progress:0: I just know I'm onto something here, ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:4284:completion:0: Now I will continue my experiments! Thank you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:4285:obj:0: Discover the location of the ⟦E2⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4285:details:0: What could they be for? I can't get the thought out of my head!
rows.quest:4285:details:1: It's driving me crazy -- that the rumors I have heard about the crystal pylons are all true. Call me gullible, but I'll usually believe anything people tell me.
rows.quest:4285:details:2: Anyway, I have heard that there is one of the crystal pylons fairly close. Somewhere in the north... Please locate it, ⟦4⟧. I just know they exist.
rows.quest:4285:completion:0: I know the stories are true, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:4287:obj:0: Discover the location of the ⟦E4⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4287:details:0: During my stay here, I have heard strange rumors about mysterious pylons existing out in the wilderness of the crater, ⟦7⟧. I guess that they are quite large, with crystals lining their interiors.
rows.quest:4287:details:1: Although I've never seen one, I can't help but think that the rumors are true -- and that the pylons have something to do with all the crystals we found
rows.quest:4287:details:2: So why don't you help me put my curiosity to rest? Supposedly, there is one in the eastern area of the crater. Do you think you can find it?
rows.quest:4287:completion:0: Un'Goro is such a strange place, ⟦9⟧. When you enter the crater, it's as if you are in a completely different world...
rows.quest:4288:details:0: My experiments so far have not yielded any positive results, ⟦10⟧. I can't help but hope that you can find a solution by searching for one of the pylons that I have heard exist.
rows.quest:4288:details:1: Perhaps if we combine certain colors at them... but I get ahead of myself. Let's find them first!
rows.quest:4288:details:2: B⟦11⟧, search the western area of the crater; a pylon is said to be somewhere in that area.
rows.quest:4288:completion:0: There are many hidden areas of the crater along the sides. Try exploring the winding paths if you can't think of anywhere else to look, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:4290:obj:0: Find the carcass of ⟦E6⟧'s freshest kill and steal a ⟦E7⟧ before returning to ⟦E8⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4290:details:0: Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of ⟦E6⟧'s kills. He didn't know it at the time, but ⟦E6⟧ saw him from the forest. ⟦E6⟧ followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave ⟦E6⟧ behind.
rows.quest:4290:details:1: ⟦E6⟧ killed him not far from this spot.
rows.quest:4290:details:2: If you want to provoke ⟦E6⟧, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it.
rows.quest:4290:progress:0: Do not take my words lightly, ⟦14⟧. If you truly wish to face this creature, then you must be careful... and smart. It will take a great deal of strength and insight to draw out ⟦E6⟧ and defeat him.
rows.quest:4290:completion:0: This will do nicely, ⟦15⟧. It seems ⟦E6⟧ eats well these days. Although, I wonder where he found a threshadon in this area. Odd.
rows.quest:4290:completion:1: Regardless, I will hold onto this until you are ready for your confrontation with the beast. Do not worry for my safety--I am sure you've angered ⟦E6⟧ enough that he will not kill me until after he's tasted your flesh.
rows.quest:4291:obj:0: Bring 2 ⟦E9⟧ Pheromone Glands to ⟦E8⟧ near the entrance to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4291:details:0: I'm actually surprised he has not come for you yet, ⟦16⟧. But all is well, for I have a final plan that will bring the monster to us.
rows.quest:4291:details:1: Being the dominant male gives ⟦E6⟧ rights to breed with any female he chooses--and he chooses many of them. You'll find many ravasaur eggs to the west of here. Get close to them and you should provoke an attack by his mates. The females produce an awful smell from a gland in their heads that allow males to know they are ready to breed. Bring me two of those glands.
rows.quest:4291:progress:0: Be careful, ⟦17⟧. Getting close to any of nest of eggs surely will provoke the mothers... even if you've already secured a gland from one. The mothers can be just as deadly as ⟦E6⟧ himself when they fight to protect their young. But, if you are successful, then we shall have a definitive way of bringing ⟦E6⟧ out from hiding.
rows.quest:4291:completion:0: Ah, fine specimens, ⟦18⟧. The two pieces you've found should be perfect for baiting ⟦E6⟧ into the open. I cannot wait to see the outcome of your fight with the monster. He is a massive thing with claws as sharp as the finest blades. You will look into his eyes and you will know death.
rows.quest:4321:details:0: The information you have given me about the pylons is very interesting...
rows.quest:4321:details:1: Give me a moment to do some calculations, ⟦19⟧. Speak to me again in a moment and I should be able to give you the answer we have been looking for.
rows.quest:4321:completion:0: Alright, ⟦20⟧. This is fascinating... I can only hope that my diagrams are correct! I compiled everything into this manual, which you can have.
rows.quest:4321:completion:1: I believe I can answer any questions you have about the crystals now, ⟦21⟧.
rows.quest:3942:details:0: Oh... ⟦E12⟧? Yeah, he's a funny one. When he first got here, he was mumbling about all kinds of strange things. Probably got bumped on the head pretty hard, I imagine.
rows.quest:3942:details:1: Something he said kinda stuck with me though -- that he was making some sort of totem; said he had to talk to someone named ⟦E10⟧... in a place called ⟦E11⟧, I think?
rows.quest:3942:details:2: I doubt he could tell you much now, though. If you want to know more, maybe you should look for Eridan yourself?
rows.quest:3942:completion:0: Hello, ⟦22⟧. Is there something I can help you with?
rows.quest:3961:obj:0: Take the ⟦E14⟧ to ⟦E12⟧ in Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:3961:details:0: To think all this time that the reason ⟦E12⟧ came here was to rid us of ⟦E15⟧... He seems like such an ordinary guy, but I did notice that he's not at all interested in any of my experiments or gadgets like most gnomes would be. He must be a true warrior at heart.
rows.quest:3961:details:1: Bring the totem to him. See if that helps him remember why he came here.
rows.quest:3961:completion:0: Did J.D. help you at all?
rows.quest:4005:obj:0: Take the ⟦E16⟧, the ⟦E17⟧, and the ⟦E18⟧ to ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:4005:obj:2: After you have the completed totem, take it to ⟦E1⟧ in Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4005:details:0: Take this bag of supplies with you to ⟦E19⟧. ⟦E22⟧ to Lost Rigger Cove, and look for a circle of stones.
rows.quest:4005:details:1: The eastmost peninsula is the secret...
rows.quest:4005:details:2: From this circle only, read from the book of Aquor; summon the only creature that can transform the items you collected into a totem to fight ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:4005:details:3: ⟦E21⟧ will not be pleased to be awakened, but remember, you must remain in the circle for him to transform the items.
rows.quest:4005:progress:0: So you're back, eh? Hmm... Let me take a look at that, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:4005:completion:1: Yes, I am aware that a strong elemental resides in the charred center of the crater. We all just keep our distance; none have been able to penetrate the powerful aura that surrounds him. Many have been pushed from the rocky paths onto the ground below when trying to face him.
rows.quest:974:obj:0: ⟦E24⟧ in ⟦E3⟧ wants you to find the hottest area of ⟦E25⟧ Plume Ridge.
rows.quest:974:obj:1: Whenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
rows.quest:974:details:0: The hot springs here are a source of mystery to me. Where does the heat come from?
rows.quest:974:details:1: Looking at how close the pools are to ⟦E25⟧ Plume Ridge, I really wonder if the volcano might have something to do with it. I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest part. It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!
rows.quest:974:details:2: Here, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!
rows.quest:974:progress:0: I'd go there myself, but... I'm a little scared of the fire elementals there!
rows.quest:974:completion:0: Yes, I definitely see the correlation here between the temperature of the volcano and the hot springs. I'll have to double-check my equations for accuracy, but it seems like the distance and the rate that the heat is transferred... Hmm...
rows.quest:980:details:0: Now, I've heard about other hot springs in a place called ⟦E26⟧, far to the north of here. The strange thing is, there are no volcanoes anywhere near them. Interesting, I know.
rows.quest:980:details:1: Well, if you want to find out more, you should head to ⟦E26⟧ and speak to a friend of mine. Her name is ⟦E27⟧, and she is currently staying by the hot springs there.
rows.quest:980:details:2: Thanks again for helping me with my thermometer! See you later!
rows.quest:980:completion:0: Hi there, ⟦25⟧. Yes, what ⟦E24⟧ told you is true...
rows.quest:4084:details:0: I do not know the one you speak of, ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:4084:details:1: But worry not; if your friend was on a journey to find me, I do know what it was he desired.
rows.quest:4084:details:2: In the heart of ⟦E3⟧ dwells evil of the purest form. This evil takes the shape of an elemental called ⟦E15⟧... protected by an aura that none can dispel...
rows.quest:4084:details:3: None... except those with enough power to do so. I can teach you of this power, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:4084:details:4: First, do as I ask. Collect 11 ⟦E17⟧ and 1 ⟦E18⟧ from the creatures in ⟦E11⟧, then return.
rows.quest:4084:progress:0: I can tell you more of the power required to defeat ⟦E15⟧, but first, you need to gather the things I require.
rows.quest:4084:completion:0: Very well, ⟦28⟧. I can see you are serious about helping your friend.
rows.quest:4289:obj:0: Bring 2 ⟦E30⟧ Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to ⟦E8⟧ at the entrance of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4289:details:0: This crater has many strange creatures--they seem to be nobler versions of the creatures found throughout my homeland and beyond. I cannot explain it, but this place cries of the Earth Mother. I pay homage to her every time I track one of her beautiful creatures across its basin.
rows.quest:4289:details:1: If you too wish to feel the enlightenment that accompanies such a great feat, then head to the north. There you'll find great apes who are a test for any mortal's strength. Bring me their pelts... prove your strength.
rows.quest:4289:progress:0: Have the creatures here bested you already, ⟦29⟧?⟦30⟧⟦31⟧Do not be dissuaded so easily. Tracking and defeating the apes of Un'Goro is no simple task, even for a great hunter.
rows.quest:4289:completion:0: So, you have proven strong, strong enough to best the great apes of Un'Goro--that is good. The challenge was small compared to ⟦E6⟧, but I will not take such a great victory away from you.
rows.quest:4289:completion:1: These pelts will make wonderful clothing for my tribe. You have helped me and proven worthy.
rows.quest:4289:completion:2: Before you set off on another task, let us give praise to the Earth Mother and thank the spirits of those apes you killed--they must know their deaths will not be wasted.
rows.quest:4301:obj:0: Bring ⟦E31⟧ to ⟦E8⟧ at the entrance of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4301:details:0: While you have been exploring Un'Goro, I have seen other things that a mighty hunter such as yourself would relish in. One such sight was a huge ape among the other gorillas to the north. You have been to that cave before, but this time, I wonder if you'll survive the encounter if you accept my task.
rows.quest:4301:details:1: I call him ⟦E32⟧, and he is one of the Earth Mother's greatest sons, of that you can be sure. Defeat ⟦E32⟧ and bring me his pelt. Do this, and I will defend your right to call yourself a great hunter.
rows.quest:4301:progress:0: ⟦E32⟧... the beast was magnificent. Huge and red, with teeth the size of daggers. His arms as thick as tree trunks, and as fast as any mountain lion I have ever laid eyes upon. You should consider yourself lucky to find such a test of bravery--my people would go generations without seeing such a creature.
rows.quest:4301:completion:0: Well done, ⟦32⟧. I am pleased. You have done a great thing here today.
rows.quest:4301:completion:1: BU'cha was one of the greatest apes I had ever seen. The fact that you have bested his strength speaks well of your own strength... and courage.
rows.quest:4301:completion:2: It is only fitting that I give you this as a sign of respect. You have earned it.
rows.quest:4491:obj:1: If ⟦E33⟧ faints, use ⟦E35⟧ to revive him.
rows.quest:4491:details:1: I was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.
rows.quest:4491:details:2: Please, help me get back to my friend ⟦E36⟧ at Marshal's Refuge. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.
rows.quest:4491:details:3: I am feeling a little out of it, so if I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from ⟦E36⟧'s canteen. That should work, I hope...
rows.quest:4491:completion:0: ⟦E33⟧'s not in the best shape, ⟦33⟧, but I am glad to have him back in one piece!
rows.quest:4492:details:0: You've got to help me, ⟦34⟧! My friend, ⟦E33⟧ left earlier to explore the volcano to the south of here, and he has been gone way too long. I am really worried about him.
rows.quest:4492:details:1: Do you think you could find him? Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find ⟦E33⟧, I'm sure he'll need it!
rows.quest:4492:completion:0: Oh... I'm so glad someone found me...
rows.quest:4501:obj:0: Kill 10 ⟦E37⟧ and 15 ⟦E38⟧, then speak to ⟦E34⟧ at Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4501:details:0: Wanted: A skilled fighter to deal with the threat of the ⟦E37⟧ that inhabit the ⟦E3⟧. Their numbers are growing, and they are becoming a menace to travelers in the area.
rows.quest:4501:details:1: Decrease the population by slaying 10 pterrordax and 15 frenzied pterrordax.
rows.quest:4501:details:2: Speak with ⟦E34⟧ after completing the task for a reward.
rows.quest:4501:progress:0: To tell you the truth, I really wasn't that worried about the strange creatures... Until the day that I saw it written on the side of a large stone.⟦35⟧⟦36⟧BEWARE OF PTERRORDAX⟦37⟧⟦38⟧Who could have written it? I don't know, but it's too creepy to just ignore!
rows.quest:4501:completion:0: I am absolutely terrified of the pterrordax here! Thank you for decreasing their numbers, ⟦39⟧. Now I might feel safe enough to venture out of Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4502:obj:0: Collect 9 samples of ⟦E40⟧ from the fire elementals around the volcano in ⟦E3⟧, and return them to ⟦E41⟧ in Ratchet.
rows.quest:4502:details:0: Being an apprentice to ⟦E42⟧, I've learned so much. But he's been gone for such a long time now, so I think I'm going to work on some experiments of my own.
rows.quest:4502:details:1: I've been reading about ⟦E3⟧ most recently, and about the strange volcanic activity going on in the middle of the crater. I think a lot could be learned if I could just get some of the ash from the elementals there.
rows.quest:4502:details:2: Do you think you'd mind collecting some for me, if you are going that way?
rows.quest:4502:progress:0: Is it true that the volcano in Un'Goro is active? I'm sure I could learn a lot with some ash from the volcano, ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:4502:completion:0: These samples will be perfect for my studies! Thank you, ⟦41⟧! I promise, you'll be the first one I will tell about my findings.
rows.quest:3962:obj:0: ⟦E22⟧ to ⟦E25⟧ Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:3962:obj:1: Find ⟦E15⟧ and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the ⟦E43⟧ from the cave.
rows.quest:3962:details:0: ⟦42⟧, I finally remember now... I did come here to fight ⟦E15⟧. I was on a journey, and this was to be the last step.
rows.quest:3962:details:1: But I am no longer the hero... You are. All that you have done -- you must finish this now, not me.
rows.quest:3962:details:2: ⟦E15⟧ guards an artifact called the ⟦E43⟧. It provides power more vast than anything else I have ever known, and it is dangerous in the hands of one with an evil heart.
rows.quest:3962:details:3: You will want to bring others with you -- it's dangerous to go alone. Take this as my advice.
rows.quest:3962:progress:0: ⟦E15⟧ is almost invincible behind the aura he has created by using the ⟦E43⟧. Only you have the power to remove it with the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:3962:completion:1: The ⟦E43⟧ will now be returned back to my homeland, where it may be protected, never again to be used for evil.
rows.quest:3962:completion:2: Since you did so much for me, I'd like you to have this. Without you, I'd still have no idea who I am!
rows.quest:4292:obj:0: Using the contents of ⟦E44⟧, summon ⟦E6⟧ and defeat him. Then bring ⟦E45⟧ to ⟦E8⟧ near the entrance to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4292:details:0: This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan. To the north of here, you will find a small trail into the mountains. It was here I saw ⟦E6⟧ last. You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby. Take the meat you recovered and place it there. Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat. If both lures mingled together do not bring ⟦E6⟧ to you, then I know nothing else that will.
rows.quest:4292:progress:0: Do not let fear overpower you, ⟦44⟧. Fear is the great betrayer... you must remain strong!⟦45⟧⟦46⟧Take the meat, place it in the small valley, and then use the gland on it. Only then will death come for you.
rows.quest:4292:completion:0: The Earth Mother be praised! You've done it! Fair play to you, ⟦47⟧. You have proven to be a great ⟦48⟧ in your own right. Your spirit is strong. Your bravery unmatched. And your strength has been fortified. I bow down to your skills.
rows.quest:4292:completion:1: Only the greatest of my ancestors could have accomplished something so incredible. Congratulations.
